dossier_meta.statement_text: Does there exist, for each integer $d$, an integer $\chi$ such that for every graph $G$ with $\chi(G)\geqslant\chi$ and every tournament $T$ on the same vertex set, there is a vertex $v$ for which $G[N^{+}_{T}(v)]$ has degeneracy at least $d$?
dossier_meta.context_text: In the closing remarks the authors note they have been unable to determine whether high chromatic number forces an out-neighbourhood with high degeneracy. The paper's disproof of Conjecture 1 shows chromatic number is not preserved, but degeneracy is a weaker measure and may behave differently.
